title: Determination of the access identities and access category associated with a request for access for UEs not operating in SNPN access mode

entities.name: Access Identity
entities.description: Standardized identifiers (0-15) that determine UE access priority based on configuration and network conditions. Used for access control and barring mechanisms.

entities.name: Access Category
entities.description: Categories (0-32) that classify the type of access attempt based on service type, priority, and network conditions. Used to determine RRC establishment cause.

entities.name: Access Attempt
entities.description: UE-initiated procedure to establish network access for various services like emergency calls, MMTEL voice/video, SMS, or data transmission.

entities.name: PLMN Selection
entities.description: Condition where UE selects a new PLMN, RPLMN, or equivalent PLMN which affects applicability of access identities.

entities.name: Multimedia Priority Service Configuration
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for Multimedia Priority Service, making access identity 1 applicable under specific PLMN conditions.

entities.name: Mission Critical Service Configuration
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for Mission Critical Service, making access identity 2 applicable under specific PLMN conditions.

entities.name: Disaster Condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is registering or registered for disaster roaming services, making access identity 3 applicable.

entities.name: Access Classes 11-15
entities.description: Special access classes (11-15) configured in UE that provide specific access privileges in HPLMN/EHPLMN or home country visited PLMNs.

relations.description: Access attempt requires determination of applicable access identities based on UE configuration and PLMN conditions.
Access attempt requires determination of applicable access category based on service type and access attempt characteristics.
Applicability of access identities 1, 2, 3, 11-15 is guarded by PLMN selection conditions (new PLMN, RPLMN, or equivalent PLMN).
Access identity 1 applicability is guarded by MPS configuration and specific PLMN conditions.
Access identity 2 applicability is guarded by MCS configuration and specific PLMN conditions.
Access identity 3 applicability is guarded by disaster condition where UE is registering/registered for disaster roaming.
Access identities 11-15 applicability is guarded by specific access class configuration and PLMN restrictions.
Access identity determination influences the access category selection process for the access attempt.
